key_insight: SciReasoner unifies proteins, molecules, and crystals into one structure-aware token language so predictions and reasoning traces stay grounded in native scientific structure.
engineering_relevance: The model suggests a practical route to explainable, multi-domain scientific AI by turning coordinates, topology, and periodic connectivity into inspectable evidence for downstream design and discovery tasks.
method: Discretizes structural information into a unified vocabulary of addressable tokens.
Performs reasoning over structural evidence under domain constraints such as stereochemistry, bonding, symmetry, energetics, and periodic order.
Generates interpretable traces for tasks including GO annotation, retrosynthesis, and materials property prediction.
evidence_signal: Across 86 benchmarks, SciReasoner reports state-of-the-art results on 67 tasks, including GO Cellular Component Fmax improving from 0.42 to 0.55 and retrosynthesis accuracy from 0.63 to 0.72.
watch_item: Tokenizing structure may improve interpretability, but performance and trace fidelity can depend on discretization choices and the quality of domain-specific structural inputs.
paper_title: Accurate, Interdisciplinary and Transparent Structure-property Understanding with Deep Native Structural Reasoning
